modules.title: λ-calculus
modules.doc:
The λ-calculus with polymorphism and subtyping, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
This file defines the subtyping relation.

## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
* See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
  this is adapted

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub
items.doc: The subtyping relation.
items.statement:
inductive Sub : Env Var → Ty Var → Ty Var → Prop
  | top : Γ.Wf → σ.Wf Γ → Sub Γ σ top
  | refl_tvar : Γ.Wf → (fvar X).Wf Γ → Sub Γ (fvar X) (fvar X)
  | trans_tvar : Binding.sub σ ∈ Γ.dlookup X → Sub Γ σ σ' → Sub Γ (fvar X) σ'
  | arrow : Sub Γ σ σ' → Sub Γ τ' τ → Sub Γ (arrow σ' τ') (arrow σ τ)
  | all (L : Finset Var) :
      Sub Γ σ σ' →
      (∀ X ∉ L, Sub (⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ) (τ' ^ᵞ fvar X) (τ ^ᵞ fvar X)) →
      Sub Γ (all σ' τ') (all σ τ)
  | sum : Sub Γ σ' σ → Sub Γ τ' τ → Sub Γ (sum σ' τ') (sum σ τ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.wf
items.doc: Subtypes have well-formed contexts and types.
items.statement: lemma wf (Γ : Env Var) (σ σ' : Ty Var) (sub : Sub Γ σ σ') : Γ.Wf ∧ σ.Wf Γ ∧ σ'.Wf Γ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.refl
items.doc: Subtypes are reflexive when well-formed.
items.statement: lemma refl (wf_Γ : Γ.Wf) (wf_σ : σ.Wf Γ) : Sub Γ σ σ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.weaken
items.doc: Weakening of subtypes.
items.statement: lemma weaken (sub : Sub (Γ ++ Θ) σ σ') (wf : (Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ).Wf) : Sub (Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ) σ σ'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.weaken_head
items.statement: lemma weaken_head (sub : Sub Δ σ σ') (wf : (Γ ++ Δ).Wf) : Sub (Γ ++ Δ) σ σ'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.narrow_aux
items.statement:
lemma narrow_aux
    (trans : ∀ Γ σ τ, Sub Γ σ δ → Sub Γ δ τ → Sub Γ σ τ)
    (sub₁ : Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ) σ τ) (sub₂ : Sub Δ δ' δ) :
      Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) σ τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.trans
items.statement: lemma trans : Sub Γ σ δ → Sub Γ δ τ → Sub Γ σ τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.narrow
items.doc: Narrowing of subtypes.
items.statement:
lemma narrow (sub_δ : Sub Δ δ δ') (sub_narrow : Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) σ τ) :
    Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ) σ τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.map_subst
items.doc: Subtyping of substitutions.
items.statement:
lemma map_subst (sub₁ : Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) σ τ) (sub₂ : Sub Δ δ δ') :
    Sub (Γ.mapVal (·[X := δ]) ++ Δ) (σ[X := δ]) (τ[X := δ])

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.strengthen
items.doc: Strengthening of subtypes.
items.statement: lemma strengthen (sub : Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.ty δ⟩ :: Δ) σ τ) :  Sub (Γ ++ Δ) σ τ

modules.title: λ-calculus
modules.doc:
The λ-calculus with polymorphism and subtyping, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
This file defines the typing relation.

## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
* See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
  this is adapted

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing
items.doc: The typing relation.
items.statement:
inductive Typing : Env Var → Term Var → Ty Var → Prop
  | var : Γ.Wf → Binding.ty σ ∈ Γ.dlookup x → Typing Γ (fvar x) σ
  | abs (L : Finset Var) :
      (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₁ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) τ) →
      Typing Γ (abs σ t₁) (arrow σ τ)
  | app : Typing Γ t₁ (arrow σ τ) → Typing Γ t₂ σ → Typing Γ (app t₁ t₂) τ
  | tabs (L : Finset Var) :
      (∀ X ∉ L, Typing (⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₁ ^ᵗᵞ fvar X) (τ ^ᵞ fvar X)) →
      Typing Γ (tabs σ t₁) (all σ τ)
  | tapp : Typing Γ t₁ (all σ τ) → Sub Γ σ' σ → Typing Γ (tapp t₁ σ') (τ ^ᵞ σ')
  | sub : Typing Γ t τ → Sub Γ τ τ' → Typing Γ t τ'
  | let' (L : Finset Var) :
      Typing Γ t₁ σ →
      (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₂ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) τ) →
      Typing Γ (let' t₁ t₂) τ
  | inl : Typing Γ t₁ σ → τ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inl t₁) (sum σ τ)
  | inr : Typing Γ t₁ τ → σ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inr t₁) (sum σ τ)
  | case (L : Finset Var) :
      Typing Γ t₁ (sum σ τ) →
      (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₂ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) δ) →
      (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Γ) (t₃ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) δ) →
      Typing Γ (case t₁ t₂ t₃) δ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.wf
items.doc: Typings have well-formed contexts and types.
items.statement: lemma wf {Γ : Env Var} {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Var} (der : Typing Γ t τ) : Γ.Wf ∧ t.LC ∧ τ.Wf Γ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.weaken
items.doc: Weakening of typings.
items.statement:
lemma weaken (der : Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).Wf) :
    Typing (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ) t τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.weaken_head
items.doc: Weakening of typings (at the front).
items.statement:
lemma weaken_head (der : Typing Δ t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Δ).Wf) :
    Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.narrow
items.doc: Narrowing of typings.
items.statement:
lemma narrow (sub : Sub Δ δ δ') (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) t τ) :
    Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ) t τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.subst_tm
items.doc: Term substitution within a typing.
items.statement:
lemma subst_tm (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ) t τ) (der_sub : Typing Δ s σ) :
    Typing (Γ ++ Δ) (t[X := s]) τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.subst_ty
items.doc: Type substitution within a typing.
items.statement:
lemma subst_ty (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) t τ) (sub : Sub Δ δ δ') :
    Typing (Γ.mapVal (·[X := δ]) ++ Δ) (t[X := δ]) (τ[X := δ])

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.abs_inv
items.doc: Invert the typing of an abstraction.
items.statement:
lemma abs_inv (der : Typing Γ (.abs γ' t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (arrow γ δ)) :
     Sub Γ γ γ'
  ∧ ∃ δ' L, ∀ x ∉ (L : Finset Var),
    Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty γ'⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ᵗᵗ .fvar x) δ' ∧ Sub Γ δ' δ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.tabs_inv
items.doc: Invert the typing of a type abstraction.
items.statement:
lemma tabs_inv (der : Typing Γ (.tabs γ' t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (all γ δ)) :
     Sub Γ γ γ'
  ∧ ∃ δ' L, ∀ X ∉ (L : Finset Var),
     Typing (⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ᵗᵞ fvar X) (δ' ^ᵞ fvar X)
     ∧ Sub (⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ) (δ' ^ᵞ fvar X) (δ ^ᵞ fvar X)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.inl_inv
items.doc: Invert the typing of a left case.
items.statement:
lemma inl_inv (der : Typing Γ (.inl t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (sum γ δ)) :
    ∃ γ', Typing Γ t γ' ∧ Sub Γ γ' γ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.inr_inv
items.doc: Invert the typing of a right case.
items.statement:
lemma inr_inv (der : Typing Γ (.inr t) T) (sub : Sub Γ T (sum γ δ)) :
    ∃ δ', Typing Γ t δ' ∧ Sub Γ δ' δ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.canonical_form_abs
items.doc: A value that types as a function is an abstraction.
items.statement:
lemma canonical_form_abs (val : Value t) (der : Typing [] t (arrow σ τ)) :
    ∃ δ t', t = .abs δ t'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.canonical_form_tabs
items.doc: A value that types as a quantifier is a type abstraction.
items.statement:
lemma canonical_form_tabs (val : Value t) (der : Typing [] t (all σ τ)) :
    ∃ δ t', t = .tabs δ t'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.canonical_form_sum
items.doc: A value that types as a sum is a left or right case.
items.statement:
lemma canonical_form_sum (val : Value t) (der : Typing [] t (sum σ τ)) :
    ∃ t', t = .inl t' ∨ t = .inr t'

modules.title: λ-calculus
modules.doc:
The λ-calculus with polymorphism and subtyping, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
This file defines the well-formedness condition for types and contexts.

## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
* See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
  this is adapted

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf
items.doc: A type is well-formed when it is locally closed and all free variables appear in a context.
items.statement:
inductive Ty.Wf : Env Var → Ty Var → Prop
  | top : Ty.Wf Γ top
  | var : Binding.sub σ ∈ Γ.dlookup X → Ty.Wf Γ (fvar X)
  | arrow : Ty.Wf Γ σ → Ty.Wf Γ τ → Ty.Wf Γ (arrow σ τ)
  | all (L : Finset Var) :
      Ty.Wf Γ σ →
      (∀ X ∉ L, Ty.Wf (⟨X,Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ) (τ ^ᵞ fvar X)) →
      Ty.Wf Γ (all σ τ)
  | sum : Ty.Wf Γ σ → Ty.Wf Γ τ → Ty.Wf Γ (sum σ τ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Env.Wf
items.doc: An environment is well-formed if it binds each variable exactly once to a well-formed type.
items.statement:
inductive Env.Wf : Env Var → Prop
  | empty : Wf []
  | sub : Wf Γ → τ.Wf Γ → X ∉ Γ.dom → Wf (⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Γ)
  | ty : Wf Γ → τ.Wf Γ → x ∉ Γ.dom → Wf (⟨x, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Γ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Env.Wf.to_ok
items.doc: A well-formed context contains no duplicate keys.
items.statement: lemma Env.Wf.to_ok {Γ : Env Var} (wf : Γ.Wf) : Γ✓

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.lc
items.doc: A well-formed type is locally closed.
items.statement: theorem lc (wf : σ.Wf Γ) : σ.LC

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.perm_env
items.doc: A type remains well-formed under context permutation.
items.statement: theorem perm_env (wf : σ.Wf Γ) (perm : Γ ~ Δ) (ok_Γ : Γ✓) (ok_Δ : Δ✓) : σ.Wf Δ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.weaken
items.doc: A type remains well-formed under context weakening (in the middle).
items.statement: theorem weaken (wf_ΓΘ : σ.Wf (Γ ++ Θ)) (ok_ΓΔΘ : (Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ)✓) : σ.Wf (Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.weaken_head
items.doc: A type remains well-formed under context weakening (at the front).
items.statement: theorem weaken_head (wf : σ.Wf Δ) (ok : (Γ ++ Δ)✓) : σ.Wf (Γ ++ Δ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.weaken_cons
items.statement: theorem weaken_cons (wf : σ.Wf Δ) (ok : (⟨X, b⟩ :: Δ)✓) : σ.Wf (⟨X, b⟩:: Δ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.narrow
items.doc: A type remains well-formed under context narrowing.
items.statement:
lemma narrow (wf : σ.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (ok : (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ)✓) :
    σ.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.narrow_cons
items.statement:
lemma narrow_cons (wf : σ.Wf (⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (ok : (⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ)✓) :
    σ.Wf (⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.strengthen
items.doc: A type remains well-formed under context strengthening.
items.statement: lemma strengthen (wf : σ.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Δ)) : σ.Wf (Γ ++ Δ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.map_subst
items.doc: A type remains well-formed under context substitution (of a well-formed type).
items.statement:
lemma map_subst (wf_σ : σ.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (wf_τ' : τ'.Wf Δ)
    (ok : (Γ.mapVal (·[X := τ']) ++ Δ)✓) : σ[X := τ'].Wf <| Γ.mapVal (·[X := τ']) ++ Δ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.open_lc
items.doc: A type remains well-formed under opening (to a well-formed type).
items.statement: lemma open_lc (ok_Γ : Γ✓) (wf_all : (Ty.all σ τ).Wf Γ) (wf_δ : δ.Wf Γ) : (τ ^ᵞ δ).Wf Γ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.of_bind_ty
items.doc: A type bound in a context is well formed.
items.statement: lemma of_bind_ty (wf : Γ.Wf) (bind : Binding.ty σ ∈ Γ.dlookup X) : σ.Wf Γ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.of_env_ty
items.doc: A type at the head of a well-formed context is well-formed.
items.statement: lemma of_env_ty (wf : Env.Wf (⟨X, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ)) : σ.Wf Γ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.of_env_sub
items.doc: A subtype at the head of a well-formed context is well-formed.
items.statement: lemma of_env_sub (wf : Env.Wf (⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ)) : σ.Wf Γ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Ty.Wf.nmem_fv
items.doc: A variable not appearing in a context does not appear in its well-formed types.
items.statement: lemma nmem_fv {σ : Ty Var} (wf : σ.Wf Γ) (nmem : X ∉ Γ.dom) : X ∉ σ.fv

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Env.Wf.narrow
items.doc: A context remains well-formed under narrowing (of a well-formed subtype).
items.statement:
lemma narrow (wf_env : Env.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (wf_τ' : τ'.Wf Δ) :
    Env.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Env.Wf.strengthen
items.doc: A context remains well-formed under strengthening.
items.statement: lemma strengthen (wf : Env.Wf <| Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Δ) : Env.Wf <| Γ ++ Δ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Env.Wf.map_subst
items.doc: A context remains well-formed under substitution (of a well-formed type).
items.statement:
lemma map_subst (wf_env : Env.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (wf_τ' : τ'.Wf Δ) :
    Env.Wf <| Γ.mapVal (·[X := τ']) ++ Δ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Env.Wf.map_subst_nmem
items.doc: A well-formed context is unchanged by substituting for a free key.
items.statement:
lemma map_subst_nmem (Γ : Env Var) (X : Var) (σ : Ty Var) (wf : Γ.Wf) (nmem : X ∉ Γ.dom) :
    Γ = Γ.mapVal (·[X := σ])

modules.title: λ-calculus
modules.doc:
The simply typed λ-calculus, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.

## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
* See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
  this is partially adapted

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Ty
items.doc: Types of the simply typed lambda calculus.
items.statement:
inductive Ty (Base : Type v)
  /-- A base type, from a typing context. -/
  | base : Base → Ty Base
  /-- A function type. -/
  | arrow : Ty Base → Ty Base → Ty Base

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing
items.doc: An extrinsic typing derivation for locally nameless terms.
items.statement:
inductive Typing : Context Var (Ty Base) → Term Var → Ty Base → Prop
  /-- Free variables, from a context judgement. -/
  | var : Γ✓ → ⟨x,σ⟩ ∈ Γ → Typing Γ (fvar x) σ
  /-- Lambda abstraction. -/
  | abs (L : Finset Var) : (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x,σ⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ fvar x) τ) → Typing Γ t.abs (σ ⤳ τ)
  /-- Function application. -/
  | app : Typing Γ t (σ ⤳ τ) → Typing Γ t' σ → Typing Γ (app t t') τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.perm
items.doc: Typing is preserved on permuting a context.
items.statement: theorem perm (ht : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) (hperm : Γ.Perm Δ) : Δ ⊢ t ∶ τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.weaken_aux
items.doc: Weakening of a typing derivation with an appended context.
items.statement: lemma weaken_aux (der : Γ ++ Δ ⊢ t ∶ τ) : (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ)✓ → (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ) ⊢ t ∶ τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.weaken
items.doc: Weakening of a typing derivation by an additional context.
items.statement: lemma weaken (der : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) (ok : (Γ ++ Δ)✓) : Γ ++ Δ ⊢ t ∶ τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.lc
items.doc: Typing derivations exist only for locally closed terms.
items.statement: lemma lc (der : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) : t.LC

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.subst_aux

    Δ ++ Γ ⊢ t[x := s] ∶ τ

items.doc: Substitution for a context weakened by a single type.

modules.title: λ-calculus
modules.doc:
Type safety of the simply typed λ-calculus, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
Theorems in this file are namespaced by their respective reductions.

## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
* See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
  this is partially adapted

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.PreservesTyping
items.doc: A relation on terms preserves typing if all related terms have the same type.
items.statement: def PreservesTyping (R : Term Var → Term Var → Prop) (Base : Type v)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.FullBeta.preservation
items.doc: Typing preservation for full beta reduction.
items.statement: theorem preservation : PreservesTyping (Var := Var) (· ⭢βᶠ ·) Base

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.FullBeta.progress
items.doc: A typed term either full beta reduces or is a value.
items.statement: theorem progress {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Base} (ht : [] ⊢ t ∶ τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᶠ t'

modules.doc: Strong normalization (termination) for full beta-reduction of simply typed lambda calculus.

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Saturated
items.doc:
A set of terms is called saturated if it

1. only contains locally closed terms,
2. only contains strongly normalizing terms,
3. contains all neutral locally closed terms, and
4. is closed under top-level β-reduction of the form (λ M) N P₁ … Pₙ → M ^ N P₁ … Pₙ.
items.statement:
structure Saturated (S : Set (Term Var)) : Prop where
  lc : ∀ M ∈ S, LC M
  sn : ∀ M ∈ S, SN FullBeta M
  neutal_lc : ∀ M, Neutral M → LC M → M ∈ S
  multiApp : ∀ M N P, LC N → SN FullBeta N → multiApp (M ^ N) P ∈ S → multiApp (M.abs.app N) P ∈ S

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.semanticMap
items.doc:
The semantic map maps each type to a corresponding saturated set of terms.
For the strong normalization proof to work, we must ensure that
Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ implies that t is in the set of terms corresponding to τ.

Strong normalization later follows from the fact that terms in saturated
sets are strongly normalizing.
items.statement: def semanticMap : Ty Base → Set (Term Var)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.semanticMap_saturated
items.doc: The sets constructed by semanticMap are saturated
items.statement: lemma semanticMap_saturated (τ : Ty Base) : @Saturated Var (semanticMap τ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.entailsContext
items.doc:
The `entailsContext` predicate ensures that each variable in the context
is mapped to a term in the corresponding semantic map.
items.statement: abbrev entailsContext (E : Term.Env Var) (Γ : Context Var (Ty Base))

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.entailsContext_empty
items.doc: The empty context is entailed by any environment.
items.statement: lemma entailsContext_empty {Γ : Context Var (Ty Base)} : entailsContext [] Γ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.entailsContext_cons
items.doc:
The `entailsContext` predicate is preserved when extending the context
with a new variable, provided the new variable is fresh and its
substitution is in the corresponding semantic map.
items.statement:
lemma entailsContext_cons (E : Term.Env Var) (Γ : Context Var (Ty Base))
    (x : Var) (τ : Ty Base) (sub : Term Var)
    (h_fresh : x ∉ E.dom ∪ E.fv ∪ Γ.dom)
    (h_mem : sub ∈ semanticMap τ) :
    entailsContext E Γ → entailsContext (⟨ x, sub ⟩ :: E) (⟨ x, τ ⟩ :: Γ)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.entails
items.doc:
The `entails` predicate states that a term `t` is
semantically valid with respect to a context `Γ` and a type `τ`
items.statement: abbrev entails (Γ : Context Var (Ty Base)) (t : Term Var) (τ : Ty Base)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.soundness
items.doc:
The `soundness` lemma states that if a term `t` has type `τ` in context `Γ`,
then `t` is semantically valid with respect to `Γ` and `τ`
items.statement: lemma soundness {Γ : Context Var (Ty Base)} (derivation_t : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) : entails Γ t τ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.strong_norm
items.doc:
Using soundness and the fact that the empty context
is entailed by any environment, we can conclude that
a well-typed term is strongly normalizing.
items.statement: theorem strong_norm {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Base} (der : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) : SN FullBeta t

modules.title: λ-calculus
modules.doc:
The untyped λ-calculus, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.

## References

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term
items.doc: Syntax of locally nameless lambda terms, with free variables over `Var`.
items.statement: inductive Term (Var : Type u)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.openRec
items.doc: Variable opening of the ith bound variable.
items.statement: def openRec (i : ℕ) (sub : Term Var) : Term Var → Term Var

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.openRec_bvar
items.statement: lemma openRec_bvar : (bvar i')⟦i ↝ s⟧ = if i = i' then s else bvar i'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.openRec_fvar
items.statement: lemma openRec_fvar : (fvar x)⟦i ↝ s⟧ = fvar x

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.openRec_app
items.statement: lemma openRec_app : (app l r)⟦i ↝ s⟧ = app (l⟦i ↝ s⟧) (r⟦i ↝ s⟧)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.openRec_abs
items.statement: lemma openRec_abs : M.abs⟦i ↝ s⟧ = M⟦i + 1 ↝ s⟧.abs

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.open'
items.doc: Variable opening of the closest binding.
items.statement: def open' {X} (e u)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.closeRec
items.doc: Variable closing, replacing a free `fvar x` with `bvar k`
items.statement: def closeRec (k : ℕ) (x : Var) : Term Var → Term Var

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.close
items.doc: Variable closing of the closest binding.
items.statement: def close {Var} [DecidableEq Var] (e u)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst
items.doc: Substitution of a free variable to a term.
items.statement: def subst (m : Term Var) (x : Var) (sub : Term Var) : Term Var

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.instHasSubstitutionTerm
items.doc: `Term.subst` is a substitution for λ-terms. Gives access to the notation `m[x := n]`.
items.statement: instance instHasSubstitutionTerm : HasSubstitution (Term Var) Var (Term Var)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.fv
items.doc: Free variables of a term.
items.statement: def fv : Term Var → Finset Var

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.closeRec_bvar
items.statement: lemma closeRec_bvar : (bvar i)⟦k ↜ x⟧ = bvar i

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.closeRec_fvar
items.statement: lemma closeRec_fvar : (fvar x')⟦k ↜ x⟧ = if x = x' then bvar k else fvar x'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.closeRec_app
items.statement: lemma closeRec_app : (app l r)⟦k ↜ x⟧ = app (l⟦k ↜ x⟧) (r⟦k ↜ x⟧)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.closeRec_abs
items.statement: lemma closeRec_abs : t.abs⟦k ↜ x⟧ = t⟦k + 1 ↜ x⟧.abs

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_bvar
items.statement: lemma subst_bvar : (bvar i : Term Var)[x := n] = bvar i

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_fvar
items.statement: lemma subst_fvar : (fvar x')[x := n] = if x = x' then n else fvar x'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_app
items.statement: lemma subst_app {l r : Term Var} : (app l r)[x := n] = app (l[x := n]) (r[x := n])

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_abs
items.statement: lemma subst_abs {M : Term Var} : M.abs[x := n] = M[x := n].abs

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_def
items.statement: lemma subst_def (m : Term Var) (x : Var) (n : Term Var) : m.subst x n = m[x := n]

modules.title: Redex Positions
modules.doc:
This module defines β-reduction at a given redex position and proves its basic properties.

## Reference

* [M. Copes, *A machine-checked proof of the Standardization Theorem in λ-calculus*][Copes2018]

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.countRedexes
items.doc: The number of β-redexes occurring in a term.
items.statement: def countRedexes : Term Var → Nat

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt
items.doc:
`BetaAt i M N` reduces the redex at position `i` of `M` to obtain `N`;
positions are counted from left to right.
items.statement: inductive BetaAt : Nat → Term Var → Term Var → Prop

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.appNoAbsL
items.doc: Reducing a non-abstraction operator keeps the position.
items.statement:
lemma BetaAt.appNoAbsL (h : BetaAt i M M') (hna : ¬IsAbs M) :
    BetaAt i (app M N) (app M' N)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.appAbsL
items.doc: Reducing an abstraction operator advances the position by one.
items.statement:
lemma BetaAt.appAbsL (h : BetaAt i M M') (ha : IsAbs M) :
    BetaAt (i + 1) (app M N) (app M' N)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.appNoAbsR
items.doc: Reducing the operand adds the redex count of a non-abstraction operator.
items.statement:
lemma BetaAt.appNoAbsR (h : BetaAt i M M') (hna : ¬IsAbs N) :
    BetaAt (i + countRedexes N) (app N M) (app N M')

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.appAbsR
items.doc: Reducing the operand adds the redex count of an abstraction operator, plus one.
items.statement:
lemma BetaAt.appAbsR (h : BetaAt i M M') (ha : IsAbs N) :
    BetaAt (i + countRedexes N + 1) (app N M) (app N M')

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.countRedexes_openRec_fvar
items.doc: Opening with a free variable preserves the number of redexes.
items.statement:
lemma countRedexes_openRec_fvar (M : Term Var) (k : Nat) (x : Var) :
    countRedexes (M⟦k ↝ fvar x⟧) = countRedexes M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.countRedexes_open_fvar
items.doc: Opening the outermost binder with a free variable preserves the number of redexes.
items.statement:
lemma countRedexes_open_fvar (M : Term Var) (x : Var) :
    countRedexes (M ^ fvar x) = countRedexes M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.countRedexes_app_le
items.doc: An application has at least as many redexes as its operator and operand combined.
items.statement:
lemma countRedexes_app_le (M N : Term Var) :
    countRedexes M + countRedexes N ≤ countRedexes (app M N)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.countRedexes_app_abs
items.doc: An application with an abstraction operator has one more redex than its parts.
items.statement:
lemma countRedexes_app_abs {M : Term Var} (ha : IsAbs M) (N : Term Var) :
    countRedexes (app M N) = countRedexes M + countRedexes N + 1

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.isAbs_r
items.doc: Contracting a redex of an abstraction yields an abstraction.
items.statement: lemma BetaAt.isAbs_r (h : BetaAt i M N) (ha : IsAbs M) : IsAbs N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.cbn_not_isAbs
items.doc: The source of a Call-by-Name step is never an abstraction.
items.statement: lemma cbn_not_isAbs (h : M ⭢ₙ N) : ¬IsAbs M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.of_cbn_step
items.doc: A single Call-by-Name step contracts the redex at position `0`.
items.statement: lemma BetaAt.of_cbn_step (h : M ⭢ₙ N) : BetaAt 0 M N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.countRedexes_subst_fvar
items.doc: Renaming a free variable preserves the number of redexes.
items.statement:
lemma countRedexes_subst_fvar [DecidableEq Var] (M : Term Var) (x y : Var) :
    countRedexes (M[x := fvar y]) = countRedexes M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.isAbs_subst_fvar
items.doc: Renaming a free variable preserves being an abstraction.
items.statement: lemma isAbs_subst_fvar [DecidableEq Var] {x y : Var} : IsAbs (M[x := fvar y]) ↔ IsAbs M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.to_step
items.doc: A `BetaAt` step is a full β-step.
items.statement: lemma BetaAt.to_step [DecidableEq Var] (h : BetaAt i M N) (lc : LC M) : M ⭢βᶠ N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.le_countRedexes
items.doc: The position of a contracted redex is at most the redex count of the result.
items.statement: lemma BetaAt.le_countRedexes (h : BetaAt i M N) : i ≤ countRedexes N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.rename
items.doc: Renaming a free variable preserves the position of the contracted redex.
items.statement:
lemma BetaAt.rename (h : BetaAt i M M') (x y : Var) :
    BetaAt i (M[x := fvar y]) (M'[x := fvar y])

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.lc_r
items.doc: Contracting a redex preserves local closure.
items.statement: lemma BetaAt.lc_r (h : BetaAt i M M') (lc : LC M) : LC M'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.abs_close
items.doc: Closing a variable and abstracting preserves the position of the contracted redex.
items.statement:
lemma BetaAt.abs_close {x : Var} (h : BetaAt i M M') (lc : LC M) :
    BetaAt i (M⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs) (M'⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN
items.doc: A single step of Call-by-Name evaluation.
items.statement: inductive CBN : Term Var → Term Var → Prop

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN.lc_l
items.doc: The left side of a Call-by-Name step is locally closed.
items.statement: lemma CBN.lc_l (step : M ⭢ₙ N) : LC M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN.step_to_redex
items.doc: A single Call-by-Name step is a full β-reduction.
items.statement: lemma CBN.step_to_redex (step : M ⭢ₙ N) : M ↠βᶠ N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN.to_redex
items.doc: Call-by-Name reduction is contained in full β-reduction.
items.statement: lemma CBN.to_redex (step : M ↠ₙ N) : M ↠βᶠ N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN.steps_app_l_cong
items.doc: Left congruence rule for application in Call-by-Name reduction.
items.statement: lemma CBN.steps_app_l_cong (step : M ↠ₙ M') (lc_N : LC N) : Term.app M N ↠ₙ Term.app M' N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN.lc_r
items.doc: The right side of a Call-by-Name step is locally closed.
items.statement: lemma CBN.lc_r (step : M ⭢ₙ N) : LC N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN.steps_lc_r
items.doc: The right side of a Call-by-Name reduction is locally closed.
items.statement: lemma CBN.steps_lc_r (lc_M : LC M) (step : M ↠ₙ N) : LC N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN.step_subst
items.doc: Substitution preserves a single Call-by-Name step.
items.statement:
lemma CBN.step_subst (x : Var) (h : M ⭢ₙ M') (lc_N : LC N) :
    M[x := N] ⭢ₙ M'[x := N]

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.CBN.steps_subst
items.doc: Substitution preserves Call-by-Name reduction.
items.statement:
lemma CBN.steps_subst (x : Var) (step : M ↠ₙ M') (lc_N : LC N) :
    M[x := N] ↠ₙ M'[x := N]

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Xi
items.doc: Congruence closure of a relation.
items.statement: inductive Xi (R : Term Var → Term Var → Prop) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Xi.step_lc_r
items.doc: The right side of a congruence step is locally closed.
items.statement: lemma step_lc_r (hR : ∀ {M' N'}, R M' N' → LC N') (step : Xi R M N) : LC N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Xi.step_lc_l
items.doc: The left side of a congruence step is locally closed.
items.statement: lemma step_lc_l (hR : ∀ {M' N'}, R M' N' → LC M') (step : Xi R M N) : LC M

modules.title: β-reduction for the λ-calculus
modules.doc:
## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*] [Chargueraud2012]
* See also https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/, from which
  this is partially adapted

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Beta
items.doc: A single β-reduction step.
items.statement: inductive Beta : Term Var → Term Var → Prop

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta
items.doc: Full β-reduction.
items.statement: abbrev FullBeta : Term Var → Term Var → Prop

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.step_lc_l
items.doc: The left side of a reduction is locally closed.
items.statement: lemma step_lc_l (step : M ⭢βᶠ M') : LC M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.redex_app_l_cong
items.doc: Left congruence rule for application in multiple reduction.
items.statement: theorem redex_app_l_cong (redex : M ↠βᶠ M') (lc_N : LC N) : app M N ↠βᶠ app M' N

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.redex_app_r_cong
items.doc: Right congruence rule for application in multiple reduction.
items.statement: theorem redex_app_r_cong (redex : M ↠βᶠ M') (lc_N : LC N) : app N M ↠βᶠ app N M'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.invert_step_app_fvar
items.statement:
lemma invert_step_app_fvar (step : app M (fvar x) ⭢βᶠ N) :
    (∃ M', N = app M' (fvar x) ∧ M ⭢βᶠ M') ∨ (∃ M1, M = abs M1 ∧ N = M1 ^ fvar x)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.step_lc_r
items.doc: The right side of a reduction is locally closed.
items.statement: lemma step_lc_r (step : M ⭢βᶠ M') : LC M'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.steps_lc_or_rfl
items.statement: lemma steps_lc_or_rfl {M M' : Term Var} (redex : M ↠βᶠ M') : (LC M ∧ LC M') ∨ M = M'

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.redex_subst_cong_lc
items.doc: Substitution of a locally closed term respects a single reduction step.
items.statement:
lemma redex_subst_cong_lc (s s' t : Term Var) (x : Var) (step : s ⭢βᶠ s') (h_lc : LC t) :
    s[x := t] ⭢βᶠ s'[x := t]

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.redex_subst_cong
items.doc: Substitution respects a single reduction step of a free variable.
items.statement:
lemma redex_subst_cong (s s' : Term Var) (x y : Var) (step : s ⭢βᶠ s') :
    s[x := fvar y] ⭢βᶠ s'[x := fvar y]

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.step_not_fv
items.doc: An β-reduction step does not introduce new free variables.
items.statement: lemma step_not_fv (step : M ⭢βᶠ N) : N.fv ⊆ M.fv

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.step_abs_close
items.doc: Abstracting then closing preserves a single reduction.
items.statement: lemma step_abs_close {x : Var} (step : M ⭢βᶠ M') : M⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs ⭢βᶠ M'⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.redex_abs_close
items.doc: Abstracting then closing preserves multiple reductions.
items.statement: lemma redex_abs_close {x : Var} (step : M ↠βᶠ M') : (M⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs ↠βᶠ M'⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs)

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.step_abs_cong
items.doc: Multiple reduction of opening implies multiple reduction of abstraction.
items.statement:
theorem step_abs_cong (xs : Finset Var) (cofin : ∀ x ∉ xs, (M ^ fvar x) ⭢βᶠ (M' ^ fvar x)) :
    M.abs ⭢βᶠ M'.abs

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.redex_abs_cong
items.doc: Multiple reduction of opening implies multiple reduction of abstraction.
items.statement:

modules.doc:
Alternative Definitions for LC:

This module defines `LcAt k M`, a more general definition of local closure. When k = 0, this is
equivalent to `LC`, as shown in `lcAt_iff_LC`.

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.LcAt
items.doc: `LcAt k M` is satisfied when all bound indices of M are smaller than `k`.
items.statement: def LcAt (k : ℕ) : Term Var → Bool

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.depth
items.doc: `depth` counts the maximum number of the lambdas that are enclosing variables.
items.statement: def depth : Term Var → ℕ

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.ind_on_depth
items.statement:
protected lemma ind_on_depth (P : Term Var → Prop) (bvar : ∀ i, P (bvar i)) (fvar : ∀ x, P (fvar x))
    (app : ∀ M N, P M → P N → P (app M N))
    (abs : ∀ M, P M → (∀ N, N.depth ≤ M.depth → P N) → P M.abs)
    (M : Term Var) : P M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.depth_openRec_fvar_eq_depth
items.doc:
The depth of the lambda expression doesn't change by opening at i-th bound variable
for some free variable.
items.statement:
lemma depth_openRec_fvar_eq_depth (M : Term Var) (x : Var) (i : ℕ) :
    (M⟦i ↝ fvar x⟧).depth = M.depth

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.depth_open_fvar_eq_depth
items.doc: The depth of the lambda expression doesn't change by opening for some free variable.
items.statement: theorem depth_open_fvar_eq_depth (M : Term Var) (x : Var) : depth (M ^ fvar x) = depth M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_le
items.statement: lemma lcAt_le (M : Term Var) (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) (lc : LcAt i M) : LcAt j M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_openRec_iff_lcAt
items.statement:
theorem lcAt_openRec_iff_lcAt (M N : Term Var) (i : ℕ) (h : LcAt i N) :
    LcAt i (M⟦i ↝ N⟧) = LcAt (i + 1) M

items.name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_open_fvar_iff_lcAt
items.doc: Opening for some free variable is locally closed if and only if `M` is `LcAt 1`.
items.statement: theorem lcAt_open_fvar_iff_lcAt (M : Term Var) (x : Var) : LcAt 0 (M ^ fvar x) = LcAt 1 M

items.doc: `M` is `LcAt 0` if and only if `M` is locally closed.
items.statement: theorem lcAt_iff_LC (M : Term Var) [HasFresh Var] : LcAt 0 M ↔ M.LC
